info.title: cosmosdbshell
info.description: Azure Cosmos DB Shell is a .NET tool with interactive navigation, query, scripting, and MCP server support for Azure Cosmos DB databases.

options.name: --color-system
options.description: Color system: 0=off, 1=standard, 2=true color (default: 2).

options.name: -c
options.description: Execute the specified command, then exit.

options.name: -k
options.description: Execute the specified command, then keep the shell running.

options.name: --clear-history
options.description: Clears command history and exits.

options.name: --connect
options.description: The endpoint URL or connection string to connect to.

options.name: --connect-mode
options.description: Connection mode: 'direct' (default) or 'gateway'

options.name: --connect-tenant
options.description: The Entra ID tenant ID to authenticate against at startup.

options.name: --connect-hint
options.description: Login hint for browser authentication at startup.

options.name: --connect-authority-host
options.description: The authority host URL at startup (default: https://login.microsoftonline.com/).

options.name: --connect-managed-identity
options.description: The client ID of a user-assigned managed identity at startup.

options.name: --connect-subscription
options.description: Azure subscription ID for ARM database and container operations at startup.

options.name: --connect-resource-group
options.description: Azure resource group name for ARM database and container operations at startup.

options.name: --mcp
options.description: Enable MCP HTTP server. Optionally specify a port with --mcp <port>; default is 6128.

options.name: --lsp
options.description: Enable Language Server Protocol (LSP) server for editor integration

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print full exception details instead of only the message.

options.name: --theme
options.description: Color theme profile to apply at startup. Falls back to the COSMOSDB_SHELL_THEME environment variable.

options.name: --diagnostics
options.description: Write timestamped diagnostic logs to a file. Optionally specify a path with --diagnostics <path>; defaults to a timestamped file in the shell configuration directory.

options.name: --otel
options.description: Enable distributed tracing so requests carry a sampled W3C traceparent. Optionally specify an OTLP endpoint with --otel <endpoint>; falls back to the OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT environment variable.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help text and exit.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show product version and exit.
NOTES:
Everything after -c / -k (or /c, /k) is taken as the command (no quoting needed). App-level options must come before -c / -k.
